name: Littlecote Roman Villa
scope: Standing Littlecote Roman Villa display in the Kennet meadow, including the archaeological wall remains and the renewed timber shelter over the Orpheus triconch and mosaic pavement.
era: Standing visitor site after the April 2026 shelter roof renewal.

originalReview.notes: Rectangular inward-facing mosaic, open timber shelter posts, crossed metal rail, low rubble caps and northern apsidal wall.

originalReview.notes: Reverse view confirms the central circular four-part medallion, triconch scallop and different red and gray border fields.

review.method: Exact Qualla historic-room photographs, statutory records and current conservation facts.
review.notes: Qualla-first source review selected exact original 2008 views with an uninterrupted unconditional public-domain dedication. The April 2026 roof replacement is described in the conservation record.
